verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs explicitly offer simple password protection for sites such as a personal portfolio, alongside Advanced Security. This directly matches the story of protecting a deployed site without building custom auth. The evidence is a single short first-party mention, with supporting notes that new projects stay private until published. missing for 10: details on how password protection is configured (per-site vs. per-deploy, UI/CLI), plan or tier availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system

citations.quote: Secure your project at any scale—whether you need the security of a banking site with Netlify Advanced Security or simple password protection for a personal portfolio site.
New projects stay private until you choose to publish.
